newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Companion Build suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Companion Build suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Companion Building Material Holdings Ltd was suspended on Monday at the request of the company pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
Companion Building said on Friday it was involved in negotiations with an independent third party, which might invest in one of the company's subsidiaries.
But no agreement had been signed and the investment may or may not materialise, it added.
Companion Building shares closed on Friday at HK$0.65, down HK$0.04.
